fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-12-23, while the incident was placed on 2025-12-21 around 22:00 hrs. The complainant, Kavitha Devi, provided the contact number 9000000412. A further person, Nandha Natarajan, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000393, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Yogesh Gopal, associated with the number 9000000376, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant noted the registration number TN-38-XX-1015 of a white car. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
